# `/auth-profiles` endpoints

Base URL: `https://{tenant}.api.identitynow.com`

### GET /auth-profiles/v1

`getProfileConfigListV1` — Get list of auth profiles

This API returns a list of auth profiles.

- Scopes: sp:auth-profile:read
- Returns 200: array of authprofilesummary

### GET /auth-profiles/v1/{id}

`getProfileConfigV1` — Get auth profile

This API returns auth profile information.

- Scopes: sp:auth-profile:read
- Parameters:
  - `id` (path, required) — ID of the Auth Profile to patch.
- Returns 200: authprofile

### PATCH /auth-profiles/v1/{id}

`patchProfileConfigV1` — Patch a specified auth profile

This API updates an existing Auth Profile. The following fields are patchable: **offNetwork**, **untrustedGeography**, **applicationId**, **applicationName**, **type**

- Scopes: sp:auth-profile:update
- Parameters:
  - `id` (path, required) — ID of the Auth Profile to patch.
- Body (application/json-patch+json): array of jsonpatchoperation
- Returns 200: authprofile
